SELECT v.*, c.name AS customer_name FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN customers c ON v.customer_id = c.id WHERE v.is_deleted = 0
AND v.customer_id = #{customerId}
AND v.plate_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{plateNumber}, '%')
AND v.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{brand}, '%')
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM vehicles WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0
